title: Law to let vehicle lessors shift idling tickets to renters
summary: This bill would require the Department of Environmental Protection to create a program letting companies that lease or rent vehicles register them so that liability for certain engine idling violations transfers to the lessee who was using the vehicle. Lessors could register their vehicles for the program, possibly for a fee, and must identify the lessee responsible at the time of the violation. The commissioner would have one year from enactment to set up the program.
